authorized_openings.scope: Prepare and locally verify one authored-synthetic, backend-free, provider-free Cloud Run-compatible static hosting package for the compiled Office taskpane and native Diary assets; external cloud, IAM, API, billing, image-push, deployment, tenant, production and release actions remain closed.

notes: Yuri accepted Cloud Run as the candidate public-HTTPS development resource and elected to await exact instructions; this authorised repository-local readiness, not cloud mutation.
The increment repairs the production build, packages a closed static surface and freezes an operator packet without reading credentials or contacting Google Cloud.
Provider, backend, product-derived data, patient, clinical, microphone, document-write, command, production and release gates remain closed.

claim_scope: A deterministic 20-file context builds a Cloud Run-compatible static image containing only the compiled taskpane, required Diary development assets, server and non-secret provenance.
The image passes non-root, read-only, capability-free, resource-bounded and internal-network checks in both local and simulated exact Sydney run.app policy modes.
The in-app browser renders only the bounded Clinician One authored-synthetic card at desktop and narrow taskpane sizes, with zero EMR backend or provider request observed.
A materialized HTTPS run.app fixture manifest passes Microsoft's validator with ReadDocument, and every task-owned runtime artifact is removed.

contract_evidence.note: The public-static readiness package adds no appointment context, proposal, confirmation or command and leaves the Reception One intent contract unchanged.
The package has no backend or database path and neither reads nor changes Diary events, availability, freshness or reconciliation.

decisions.summary: Accept the repository-local synthetic-only Cloud Run-compatible public-host package and operator contract without creating or changing any external cloud resource.

title: Raisa Cloud Run Public-HTTPS Development Host Readiness
unresolved_gates: Cloud Run and Artifact Registry API enablement and entitlement are unverified.
Creating the dedicated runtime identity, repository, public service, IAM binding, image push and deployment requires explicit external authority.
Authenticated Word Online loading, Office identity and clinician-role authorization remain unproven.
Real, product-derived, patient, health, clinical and historical text remain closed.
Provider, Access AI, backend, database, microphone, document-write, clinical-command, production and release remain closed.
